name: Kohaku no Yume
source:
Wishing that she had never even existed, Mishiro Usui threw herself into the lake.
When she came to, she was in the Mirror World, a place neither heaven nor hell.
There, her reflection instructed her: "Find the mirrors in this world, and break them."

[From [url=https://vgperson.com/games/blankdream.htm]Vgperson's translation page[/url]]
translation:
希望自己从未存在过的碓冰深白，纵身跃入湖中。
再度醒来时，她置身于“镜之世界”——一个既非天堂、也非地狱的地方。
在那里，镜中的自己向她发出指示：“找到这个世界里的镜子，然后打碎它们。”

[摘自[url=https://vgperson.com/games/blankdream.htm]Vgperson的翻译页面[/url]]
